Switching language reloads the page. The score you are editing is kept; the undo history is cleared.
Saves the score in this browser after every edit, so a refresh or restart picks it up again. Nothing is uploaded to the server.
Rows outside the key are dimmed. It is only a hint and never blocks anything.
When on, the top-left corner of the piano roll shows the opening time signature and a right click changes it; right-click the bar ruler to set a meter change. Bar lines, cells per bar, inserting and deleting bars, and MML line breaks all follow the meter.
Tempo, note length, octave and volume each get their own colour; notes and durations stay white. Characters the parser cannot read get a red wavy underline, and anything past 2400 characters gets a red background. It is only a hint and never blocks anything.
Line breaks are formatting only — whitespace does not count towards the game's character limit. A note held across a bar line cannot be split, so that line runs longer and the numbering skips.

About

About this tool

夜光 MML Workshop is an online MML score editor for Mabinogi Mobile. Nothing to install — open it and start writing, preview with a soundfont close to the game's own, then copy the MML back into the game's blank score. You can import a MIDI file and convert it automatically, draw notes by dragging in the piano roll, use compression and optimisation to fit the 2,400-character-per-track limit, and share a link when you are done.

Writing MML for Mabinogi on PC instead? Head to the Mabinogi MML Score Editor

Technologies used
  • SpessaSynth 4.3 — WebAudio synthesis engine; handles SF2/DLS parsing and real-time AudioWorklet playback. Apache-2.0
  • Audiveris 5.11.0 — Optical music recognition; turns images of sheet music into MML. Open-sourced as its licence requires — public repo. AGPL-3.0
  • lamejs : mp3 encoding. Licensed LGPL-3.0
  • Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 — Icon font; only the solid and regular sets are loaded. CC BY 4.0
  • Google Fonts — Gloock, IBM Plex Mono, and Noto switched by interface language. OFL

MML parsing and compression, bzip2, ZIP packaging and the piano roll are all written in-house — the front end has no other runtime dependencies.

Paste MML

This browser will not let the page read the clipboard. Press Ctrl+V below, then press Load.

Clipboard

MML is plain text. Use the clipboard to move it between the game's Blank Score and here.

Pasting replaces the contents of every tab. Copying strips whitespace — that is what the game counts.

File

New / Save

“Create New” starts a brand new file: track count, instruments and the file name all go back to default; key signature and line-wrap settings are kept. Ctrl+Z undoes it.

Import

Voices in the file that contain notes are listed for you to tick, up to 15 tracks. Importing replaces the contents of every tab, including the aux tracks.

OMR by Audiveris (AGPL-3.0). Up to about 90% accurate — you will still need to fix notes by hand.

Export
Clear

Clears the score text of all 15 tracks, leaving 3 empty tracks.Instrument choices, file name and key signature are kept. Ctrl+Z undoes it.

Import sheet music (images)

If you have a PDF, upload the PDF — it is recognised in one pass, tempo and time signature apply to the whole piece, and you don’t have to pick a resolution. With images, one piece is a stack of images and top-left to bottom-right is the page order; scan at 300 DPI or higher, a phone snapshot is noticeably worse.

No files yet.

Drag the thumbnails to reorder — this is the page order, and getting it wrong ruins the whole piece. Recognition takes tens of seconds to a few minutes; don't close this while it runs.

Tick # Channel Notes Capture mode

Each track can only hold one note at a time.Favour melodytakes the highest of the simultaneous notes;Favour roottakes the lowest; Bothkeeps high and low in two separate tracks;
Smart voice splituses 4 tracks to separate the melody from the accompanying chords; Full chord captureuses all 15 tracks to capture as many notes as possible;

These voices are already monophonic MML, so they are moved across as-is, without recompression. A track marked read-only had unrecognised characters in the source; the text is still editable.

Sharing requires signing in. If a copyright dispute arises, this site is legally required to notify the sharer to take the score down (Article 90-6 of the Copyright Act), so sharing must leave a working email address we can reach you at.
